_comment_lsp: Built-in csharp LSP auto-starts on .cs/.csx files when .NET SDK is installed (https://opencode.ai/docs/lsp/). This project only contains WinUI 3 C# + XAML — no .razor/.cshtml — so the built-in coverage is sufficient and we deliberately do NOT add a custom C# LSP per policy §8 (no native LSP duplication). razor/.razor and clojure-lsp etc. stay built-in but inert because their file extensions are absent.
_comment_mcp: Project-local MCP servers. All pinned to exact versions / remote URLs for reproducibility (policy §6 'version / pinning'). Each consumes context — the opencode docs explicitly warn GitHub MCP is heavy, so github stays opt-in (enabled=false) and microsoft-learn stays default-on because vendor Microsoft docs are first-class for WinUI 3 / .NET 9 / Windows App SDK 1.7 work.

microsoft-learn._comment: Official Microsoft Learn docs at https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp (Microsoft, MIT, repo: github.com/microsoftdocs/mcp). This is a REMOTE Streamable HTTP MCP server — no key, no auth, no local install. Use when querying vendor APIs (WindowsAppSDK 1.7, WinUI 3 controls, .NET 9 APIs) that the LLM's training data may not cover.

github._comment: @modelcontextprotocol/server-github (Anthropic, MIT) — local stdio MCP. Opt-in (enabled=false) per opencode docs warning that this server adds a lot of tokens. Enable per-session when you need to inspect PRs, CI runs, releases, or issue threads. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var (classic PAT with repo:read + actions:read).
